id: # The unit classes of military-units-and-tactics.md (manual p.14). One row for each class of unit.
# weapon: the weapon key of weapons.tsv that the unit carries (one for each soldier, or one item for a siege weapon or a ship), or - (sword, boat, transport).
# aptitude: the officer aptitude that counts (spear, halberd, crossbow, cavalry, siege, navy, none).
# move: 22 foot, 28 cavalry, 18 siege (observed, guide book p.36 to p.47). The navy and the transport values are assumed (Q-168).
# attack, defence, destroy: the grades S A B C D E of the manual, or - (documented). The percent of each grade is in rules.tsv (assumed, Q-168).
# range: the hexes of a normal attack (1, or 2 for an arrow attack; documented). can_attack: siege weapons cannot attack (documented). counterattack: siege weapons do not counterattack (documented).
